site.about_desc_1: Born and raised in Vinh Lap – Thanh Ha – Hai Duong, known as the “land of lychee,” I deeply understand the many hardships faced by local farmers here. This land is beautiful but poor, surrounded by rivers on all sides, with limited trade and transport. There was a time when I felt so insecure about my hometown that I did not dare tell my friends I was from Vinh Lap.
site.about_desc_2: When we brought our hometown lychees to introduce to friends in Japan, I realized something important: the place I once felt insecure about was in fact a place to be truly proud of. I understood that I had to do something so that the younger generation growing up here could confidently say: “I was born in Vinh Lap.”
site.about_desc_3: From that aspiration, I began the journey of bringing lychee – the essence of Thanh Ha’s land and sky – to the world. LALA-LYCHEEE was founded with the mission of bringing Vinh Lap lychees to international friends, creating more jobs for local people, so that after each lychee season they would no longer face unemployment or have to leave home to earn a living.
site.founder_quote: Bringing pride back to our homeland.
site.about_footer_quote: Each product is a work of art, crafted from carefully selected ingredients and a deep love for our homeland.
site.mission_desc: To bring Vinh Lap lychee – the essence of Thanh Ha’s land and sky – to the world, creating sustainable jobs for local farmers so that future generations of Vinh Lap can proudly say: “I was born in Vinh Lap.”
site.vision_desc: To become a leading Vietnamese agricultural brand recognized in international markets, helping elevate the value of Vietnamese farm products and bringing a better life to local farmers.
site.craft_subheading: The journey from fresh lychees to refined products in your hands.

story.hero_description: From the self-doubt of someone far from home to the aspiration of bringing Vinh Lap pride to the world.
story.chapter1_location_text: "Surrounded by rivers, where people worked hard all year round..."
story.chapter1_content1: I was born and raised in Vinh Lap – Thanh Ha – Hai Duong, the cradle of the lychee tree. But back then, all I could see was hardship. This land was beautiful, yet trade was limited and life was full of difficulties.
story.chapter1_quote: "There was a time when I felt so insecure about my hometown that I did not dare tell my friends I was from Vinh Lap."
story.chapter2_content1: Ten years of studying and working in Japan changed my life. There, I met my life partner — a Japanese language teacher.
story.chapter2_content2: When we returned to Vietnam together, it was through her eyes that I saw my hometown again. She showed me the beauty of neighborhood bonds, the peacefulness of the rivers, and above all, the extraordinary flavor of the lychee I had long taken for granted.
story.chapter2_item1: The genuine beauty of Vinh Lap’s people
story.chapter2_item2: A one-of-a-kind lychee flavor found nowhere else
story.quote_text: "We shared our hometown lychees with friends in Japan. From the surprise in their eyes, I realized that the place I once felt insecure about was actually the place I should be most proud of."
story.video_description: Discover the journey of bringing Vinh Lap lychee to the world through the eyes of those who lived it
story.chapter3_small_label: The Original Thanh Ha Lychee Tree
story.chapter3_content1: The mission of LALA-LYCHEEE is not simply to sell fruit. It is a journey to affirm the value of Vietnamese agriculture, so that future generations of Vinh Lap can proudly say: "I was born in Vinh Lap."
story.chapter3_card1_content: Japanese-standard cultivation processes that preserve the fruit’s natural flavor.
story.chapter3_card2_content: Creating sustainable livelihoods so that farmers do not have to leave their hometowns.
